name: tangible/ddd-core
description: Host-neutral DDD runtime: CQRS over Tactician, domain events, outbox, processes and ports, with in-memory doubles and a PDO default.

suggest.ext-pdo: Required by the TangibleDDD\Defaults\Pdo adapter set, which runs over a PDO connection the host already owns.
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: Required only by the DI bridge TangibleDDD\Infra\DependencyInjection (DDDCompilerPasses, LongProcessCatalogPass).
